header.title: How to Install a Dual Fuel Range
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely install a dual fuel range, covering everything from understanding the appliance to connecting the gas line and final checks.

steps.description: This step explains the characteristics and benefits of dual fuel ranges, focusing on the use of gas for the cooktop and electricity for the oven.
actions: Understand the concept of dual fuel ranges.
Recognize that gas provides enhanced temperature regulation for cooktop cooking.
Consider the potential cost savings of using a gas cooktop.
Note that the oven is typically electrically operated.

steps.description: This step involves preparing the installation area for the new dual fuel range, including checking utilities and ensuring secure connections.
actions: Clean the area where the old stove was placed.
Check for new electric lines for the oven.
Inspect the quality of pipes for the gas source.
Ensure gas pipes from the source to the cooktops are firmly and safely fastened.

steps.description: This step details connecting a gas hose to the stove and gas pipe, including removing a cap and using Teflon tape.
actions: Remove the cap of the gas line using an adjustable wrench (if applicable)
Wrap the fitting on top of the stove with Teflon tape
Screw a flex hose end to the fitting along the gas stove
Tighten the flex hose end using an adjustable wrench
Screw the other flex hose end onto the gas pipe coming up through the floor
Tighten the flex hose end using a wrench
Switch on the dual fuel range gas supply
steps.part: Gas Hose, Gas Line, Fitting, Flex Hose End, Gas Pipe

steps.description: This step advises on selecting a range fuel type, considering safety, existing kitchen design, budget, and installation concerns.
actions: Consider safety while cooking.
Assess kitchen design limitations for fuel choice.
Evaluate budgeting for dual-fuel ranges.
Review installation requirements for dual-fuel ranges.
Check piping for the gas source.
Check wiring for the electricity line.
